title: EP 7: Tech Chaos: AI Layoffs, Canada Population Crash & Pentagon’s AI War Drama
description:
AI layoffs, Canada’s population slowdown, AI ethics in warfare, and… safe Toronto drivers?!

In this episode we break down four fascinating stories shaping tech, policy, and everyday life. From companies blaming AI for massive layoffs, to Canada potentially hitting zero population growth, to a showdown between AI companies and the military over how AI should be used in war. And just when things get intense… we end with a surprising twist: Toronto might actually be one of the safest places to drive in Ontario. 😅

🔎 Topics We Discuss
🤖 AI Layoffs Drama
Block, Inc. cut thousands of employees while claiming AI can replace large teams. Is this real automation—or corporate “AI hype”?

🇨🇦 Canada’s Population Turning Point
A major policy shift could push Canada toward zero population growth, raising big questions about immigration, housing, and the economy.

⚔️ AI vs The Military
Anthropic is clashing with the U.S. defense establishment over whether AI systems like Claude should be used for surveillance or autonomous weapons.

🚗 Toronto Drivers Shock Everyone
Despite the memes, Toronto ranks among the safest cities in Ontario for driving. Plot twist!

title: We Need AI Regulation in the UK Before 2027
description:
PauseAI UK Director Joseph Miller discusses our recent open letter on DeepMind's broken promises and the upcoming AI bill in the UK.

This was filmed at a screening of Michael Trazzi's SB 1047 documentary in parliament, hosted by Iqbal Mohamed MP.

Watch the SB 1047 documentary here - https://youtu.be/JQ8zhrsLxhI
